pages.title: GREENKEEPER NEUTRALIZED
pages.text: The Core's excavator lies still. The bunker has room to breathe.

pages.title: ARRAY SECURED
pages.text: The feedhorn held through the 72-second lock. The array is safe for now.

pages.title: FIRST CONTACT
pages.text: FASR-001 answered the receiver. The message remains in your records.

pages.title: SIGNAL TESTED
pages.text: The lab recorded a validation and its deployment decision.

pages.title: OHIO SECURED
pages.text: The Core's hold on Big Ear is broken. Your next destination is Neo-Denver, where Synchronicity controls the blackout sector. Follow the road out of Ohio.
